opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher education institutions, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations. The Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects at UK universities and higher education institutions. The outline stage is currently paused; detailed applications are being accepted by the 1 September 2026 deadline.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions invite an eminent senior professor from overseas. Application must be made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Brings genuinely novel expertise from an eminent overseas professor to enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and clinical research

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £130,000 (Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year 1, 50% up to £28,000 in years 2-3, plus up to £6,000/year research expenses)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post. Must hold a doctorate by the time of taking up the Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Enables early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, with the aim of leading to a more permanent position.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships (Centenary round)

amount.raw: Up to £5 million per award (ten awards)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers. Consortia of up to two universities are allowed.
opportunities.summary: Funds up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area for the institution. The page states the scheme is 'now open for submission in March 2026'.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical and policy-driven research

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Enables distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, funding replacement salary costs.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers in any discipline holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Enables experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties, to complete a piece of research. Application materials will be available in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK, with an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: Enables senior researchers who have retired to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Application materials will be available in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres (Centenary round)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Expected to open in February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary round)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars embarking on a university career, at lecturer level or equivalent, with at least two years' experience after PhD award.
opportunities.summary: Enables talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical and policy-driven research
